program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_pass": (11.0, 7.0, 15.0),
    "L_pass":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),
    "I_tail":    (10e-6, 6e-6, 16e-6),
    "gmid_in":   (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),
    "L_in":      (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Cc1":       (20e-12, 5e-12, 60e-12),
    "Cc2":       (10e-12, 3e-12, 40e-12),
    "Cm":        (1.5e-12, 0.3e-12, 5e-12),
    "I_div":     (2e-6, 1e-6, 5e-6),
    "Vs_n":      (0.25, 0.15, 0.40),
    "Vsd_in":    (0.20, 0.12, 0.35),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd_s = 1.8
    vref = spec["vref"]; vo = spec["vout_target"]
    imax = spec["iload_max"]; imin = spec["iload_min"]; cl = spec["cl"]
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It = p["I_tail"]; Ih = It / 2.0
    Ip = It / 5.0                      # PMOS-bias branch, mirrored x5 into the tail
    Lp = p["L_pass"]

    # ---------------- pass device (sized at max load) ----------------
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], Lp, imax, vds=vdd_s - vo)
    Wp = mp.W
    nfp = int(max(1, min(200, math.ceil(Wp / 40.0))))

    # light-load operating point via bisection on VSG
    lo, hi = 0.2, 1.6
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, mid, vdd_s - vo)["Id"] < imin:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    opl = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, hi, vdd_s - vo)
    gm_pl, gds_pl, vsg_l = opl["gm"], opl["gds"], hi
    gm_ph, gds_ph, vsg_h = mp.gm, mp.gds, mp.vgs

    # ---------------- error amplifier ----------------
    # PMOS EA pair (bulk = supply); iterate once for body effect
    m_in = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ih, vds=p["Vsd_in"], vsb=0.0)
    T = vref + m_in.vgs
    m_in = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ih, vds=p["Vsd_in"], vsb=max(0.0, vdd_s - T))
    T = vref + m_in.vgs                          # tail node
    P = T - p["Vsd_in"]                          # EA pair drains (cascode sources)
    m_pc = lut.size("p", 14.0, 0.5, Ih, vds=0.4, vsb=0.0)    # PMOS cascodes, bulk = own source
    Vcp = P - m_pc.vgs
    m_tail = lut.size("p", 12.0, 1.0, It, vds=max(0.15, vdd_s - T))
    m_pd = lut.size("p", 12.0, 1.0, Ip, vds=m_tail.vgs)      # diode reference for the tail
    pb = vdd_s - m_pd.vgs
    Rp = max(1e3, (pb - Vcp) / Ip)

    # NMOS mirror loads + NMOS cascodes (low-voltage cascode mirror)
    m_n = lut.size("n", 14.0, 1.0, Ih, vds=p["Vs_n"])
    m_nc = lut.size("n", 18.0, 0.5, Ih, vds=0.4, vsb=p["Vs_n"])
    Vcn = p["Vs_n"] + m_nc.vgs
    m_b = lut.size("n", 14.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.5)            # ibias diode reference
    m_ns = lut.size("n", 14.0, 1.0, Ip, vds=0.4)             # sink for the PMOS-bias branch
    Rb = max(1e3, (Vcn - m_b.vgs) / iref)                    # ibias node = Vcn

    # feedback divider
    R2 = vref / p["I_div"]
    R1 = (vo - vref) / p["I_div"]
    beta = R2 / (R1 + R2)

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mp, m=nfp)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    # bias
    n.R("Rb", "ibias", "nb", Rb)
    n.dev("Mb", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", m_b)
    n.dev("Mns", "vcp", "nb", "vss", "vss", m_ns)
    n.dev("Mpd", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", m_pd)
    n.R("Rp", "pb", "vcp", Rp)
    n.dev("Mtail", "t", "pb", "vin", "vin", m_tail)
    # diff pair: fb on the diode side, vref on the output side
    n.dev("M1", "p1", "fb", "t", "vin", m_in)
    n.dev("M2", "p2", "vref", "t", "vin", m_in)
    n.dev("M1c", "d1", "vcp", "p1", "p1", m_pc)
    n.dev("M2c", "g", "vcp", "p2", "p2", m_pc)
    n.dev("M3c", "d1", "ibias", "s3", "vss", m_nc)
    n.dev("M4c", "g", "ibias", "s4", "vss", m_nc)
    n.dev("M3", "s3", "d1", "vss", "vss", m_n)
    n.dev("M4", "s4", "d1", "vss", "vss", m_n)
    # current-buffer compensation (both polarities) + small direct Miller cap
    n.C("Cc1", "vout", "s4", p["Cc1"])
    n.C("Cc2", "vout", "p2", p["Cc2"])
    n.C("Cm", "vout", "g", p["Cm"])

    # ---------------- predictions ----------------
    gm1 = m_in.gm
    Ro_up = m_pc.gm / max(m_pc.gds * m_in.gds, 1e-30)
    Ro_dn = m_nc.gm / max(m_nc.gds * m_n.gds, 1e-30)
    Yg = 1.0 / Ro_up + 1.0 / Ro_dn
    A_ea = gm1 / Yg
    Gdiv = 1.0 / (R1 + R2)

    # load regulation: closed-loop Rout (worst at light load) + systematic EA offset shift
    rout_cl = 1.0 / (gds_pl + Gdiv + beta * A_ea * gm_pl)
    dvg = abs(vsg_h - vsg_l)
    off_shift = dvg * Yg / gm1 / beta
    load_reg = rout_cl + off_shift / (imax - imin)

    # line regulation (DC)
    frac_dn = (1.0 / Ro_dn) / Yg
    line_reg = max((gds_pl + gm_pl * frac_dn) * Yg / (gm_pl * beta * gm1),
                   (gds_ph + gm_ph * frac_dn) * Yg / (gm_ph * beta * gm1))

    # PSRR at 1 kHz (gate tracks supply through Cgs; loop via EA gm and the comp caps)
    w = 2 * PI * 1e3
    cgs = max(mp.cgg - mp.cgd, 0.5 * mp.cgg)
    Ctot = p["Cc1"] + p["Cc2"] + p["Cm"] + mp.cgd
    def psrr(gm_p, gds_p):
        ygac = Yg + 1j * w * cgs
        num = gds_p + gm_p * (1.0 / Ro_dn) / ygac
        den = gds_p + Gdiv + 1j * w * cl + gm_p * (beta * gm1 + 1j * w * Ctot) / ygac
        return 20 * math.log10(abs(den / num))
    psrr_1k = min(psrr(gm_pl, gds_pl), psrr(gm_ph, gds_ph))

    # load-step undershoot: charge Cc1 * dV is injected into the gate through M4c
    Cg = mp.cgg + p["Cm"]
    k_inj = (p["Cc1"] + p["Cm"] + mp.cgd) / Cg
    undershoot = 1.4 * dvg / (1.0 + k_inj) + 0.01
    k_inj2 = (p["Cc2"] + p["Cm"] + mp.cgd) / Cg
    overshoot = 1.4 * dvg / (1.0 + k_inj2) + 0.01

    # damping estimate (2nd-order: s^2 CL Cg + s(gm_p Ctot + G Cg) + gm_p * Yf)
    def zeta(gm_p, gds_p, yf, cder):
        w0 = math.sqrt(gm_p * yf / (cl * Cg))
        return (gm_p * cder + (gds_p + Gdiv) * Cg) / (2 * cl * Cg * w0)
    z_light = zeta(gm_pl, gds_pl, beta * gm1, Ctot)
    z_heavy = zeta(gm_ph, gds_ph, beta * gm1 + m_nc.gm + m_pc.gm, p["Cm"] + mp.cgd)
    ripple = 0.002 if min(z_light, z_heavy) > 0.15 else 0.02

    iq = iref + It + Ip + p["I_div"]
    vout_err = 100.0 * (abs(off_shift) * 0.5 + 1e-4) / vo

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": psrr_1k,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "overshoot": overshoot,
        "ripple_settled": ripple,
        "loop_gain_dc_db": db(beta * A_ea * gm_pl / (gds_pl + Gdiv)),
        "zeta_light": z_light,
        "zeta_heavy": z_heavy,
        "W_pass_um": Wp,
    }

events.topology: PMOS-pass LDO, telescopic PMOS-input EA with dual current-buffer (Ahuja) compensation into both cascode sources
